meta.convention: Bracket arrays use {rate (percent), from, to}; 'to' null means no upper limit. 'from'/'to' are taxable-income thresholds in the stated currency. read_from 'page' means the official page or PDF was fetched and the figures read there; 'search-summary' means the figure came from a search-engine summary and was not read on an official page.

brackets_single.note: IRS newsroom release of Rev. Proc. 2025-32 inflation adjustments, reflecting the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. Married filing separately uses the single standard deduction; MFS bracket thresholds were not read.

brackets_married_filing_jointly.note: MFJ thresholds are exactly double single up to the 35% bracket; the 37% threshold (768,700) is not double (1,281,200), which is the federal marriage penalty at the top.

standard_deduction_single.note: Also applies to married filing separately.

cohabiting_unmarried.note: Unmarried cohabiting partners cannot file jointly; each files single, or head of household if they separately qualify (unmarried, pays more than half the cost of a home for a qualifying person). A partner is generally not a qualifying person for HoH. Stated from general knowledge of the filing-status rules; no official page fetched in this pass. Same applies in NY, CA and CT, which follow federal filing status (CA also treats registered domestic partners as married).

nys_brackets_married_filing_jointly_2025.note: MFJ and qualifying surviving spouse. Base tax: 686 / 976 / 1,202 / 8,553 / 18,252 / 143,754 / 418,263 / 2,478,263. MFJ thresholds are not simply double single (e.g. 5,000,000 is the same for both), so NY has a top-end marriage penalty.

nys_2026_rate_change.note: FY2026 budget (Ch. 59 L.2025 Part A): bottom five rates cut 0.1 point for TY2026 and a further 0.1 point from TY2027, for taxable income up to 215,400 single / 323,200 joint. nyc_resident_tax_married_filing_jointly_.note: Base tax 665 / 1,545 / 3,264. NYC 2026 schedule not checked.

value.backdating: up to 4 previous tax years; gov.uk currently says back to 6 April 2022 (2022-23)

marriage_allowance_eligibility.note: Scotland upper figure from the same page; Scottish rate bands differ.

married_couples_allowance_2026_27.note: Max and min read on gov.uk (2025-26: 11,270 / 4,360). Eligibility (married or civil partners living together, one born before 6 April 1935) from https://www.gov.uk/married-couples-allowance (page). The income limit 39,200 is search-summary only (litrg / Commons Library), not read on gov.uk. Relief given at 10%, so the tax reduction is 1,170 max / 453 min for 2026-27 (derived); the gov.uk MCA page shows the older 436-1,127 range. Allowance reduced by 1 per 2 of income over the limit, down to the minimum.

cohabitees.note: Both Marriage Allowance and MCA require marriage or civil partnership; unmarried cohabitees are taxed wholly independently. UK income tax is individual for everyone; there is no joint filing.

value.joint: taxed on combined income via an assessable spouse (higher earner by default); most credits, reliefs and the rate band can be allocated between spouses
value.separate: each taxed as single in the year but unused credits/reliefs/bands can be transferred; married personal credit, age, blind and incapacitated child credits split equally
value.single_individualised: each treated as a single person with single credits and band; no transfer

assessment_options.note: Joint assessment read on revenue.ie; separate and single descriptions from search summary (revenue.ie separate-assessment page, citizensinformation). Non-transferable even under joint assessment: Employee Tax Credit, Earned Income Tax Credit, employment expenses, and the increase in the standard rate band.

standard_rate_band_single.note: Balance at 40%. Same in 2025 (Budget 2026 left the band unchanged).

standard_rate_band_married_two_incomes.note: Increase is the lower of 35,000 or the lower earner's income, and is not transferable. max_total is derived.

personal_tax_credit_married_or_civil_par.note: Per couple; transferable under joint assessment.

value.taper: reduced by half the excess of the carer's income over 7,200

home_carer_tax_credit.note: Requires joint assessment and a home carer caring for a dependent person. Cannot be combined with the increased standard rate band for a second income in the same year (choose the better; standard Revenue rule, not re-read here).

cohabitants.note: Cohabitants are separate unconnected individuals; no joint assessment, no transfer of credits or band. Revenue's joint-assessment page limits the option to married people and civil partners.

federal_lowest_rate_2026.note: Lowest rate fell from 15% to 14% on 1 July 2025 (2025 blended 14.5%); 2026 is the first full year at 14%. Non-refundable credits are worth 14% of the base amount. Source is TaxTips.ca, not canada.ca (CRA 2026 rate page URL returned 404).

federal_brackets_2026.note: Canada has no joint filing; every individual files separately.

federal_basic_personal_amount_2026.note: Maximum BPA; it is clawed back for high incomes (not captured).

mexico_city_incausado.note: Art. 266 as rendered on leyes-mx: no cause required, 'siempre que haya transcurrido cuando menos un ano desde la celebracion'. CONFLICTS with the brief ('no waiting'); there may be later reform or SCJN rulings removing the year - verify against the official Gaceta text. No separation required.

england_and_wales.value: judicial discretion under MCA 1973 s25; equality as a yardstick
england_and_wales.note: White v White [2000]: equal division is a yardstick/cross-check, not a presumption; Miller/McFarlane [2006]: needs, sharing, compensation. First consideration is welfare of minor children.

ireland.value: 'proper provision' at court's discretion; no presumption of equal division
ireland.note: Family Law (Divorce) Act 1996 s20: factors include income, earning capacity, needs, contributions, conduct, accommodation, pensions.

ontario.value: equalization of net family property: spouse with lower NFP gets half the difference
ontario.note: Family Law Act s5(1); unequal only if unconscionable (s5(6)). Exclusions (s4(2)) not verified in this pass; e-Laws page did not render.

british_columbia.value: equal division of family property and family debt; excluded property kept
british_columbia.note: Family Law Act s81 (equal entitlement regardless of use or contribution); s85 excluded property: pre-relationship property, inheritances, third-party gifts, certain settlements/insurance, discretionary-trust interests, and property derived from these (growth in value of excluded property is family property).

mexico_city.value: sociedad conyugal (50/50 of the society's assets on liquidation) or separacion de bienes (each keeps own) with compensation up to 50% for the homemaker spouse
mexico_city.note: Art. 178: must choose one of the two regimes. Default when omitted/unclear: sociedad conyugal per secondary sources (abogadosencdmx.com citing art. 178; art. 182 Ter presumes assets belong to the society) - not confirmed by an official text that states the default explicitly. Art. 267 VI: under separacion de bienes, compensation 'no podra ser superior al 50% del valor de los bienes que hubieren adquirido' to the spouse who mainly did housework/childcare; SCJN upheld it as constitutional.

ncs_universal_subsidy_hourly.unit: per child per hour, max 45 hrs/week (up to €96.30/week)
ncs_universal_subsidy_hourly.note: Page gives €96.30/week universal max; €96.30/45 = €2.14 (derived, matches search summary). Not income-tested; for children not yet in ECCE/school (verify age scope).

ncs_income_assessed_max_hourly.unit: per child per hour, maximum (child 24-52 weeks, income <= lower threshold)
ncs_income_assessed_max_hourly.note: Previously €4.40 at €34k income. Rates are lower for older children.

ncs_lower_income_threshold.unit: reckonable (net) family income, at or below = max rate

ncs_upper_income_threshold.unit: reckonable income above which only universal subsidy
ncs_upper_income_threshold.note: Was €60,000. Multiple-child income discounts now €5,500 (2 children) and €11,000 (3+). At €60,000 the rate rises from €2.14 to €2.84/hr.

core_funding_fee_cap_45h_weekly.unit: maximum provider fee for a full-day place, 45 hrs/week (8am-5pm), before NCS subsidy
core_funding_fee_cap_45h_weekly.note: Was €198. 50+ hrs (7am-6pm) capped at €239.70/week. Applies to services in Core Funding. Government target: €200/month parent cost; further cuts flagged for Budget 2027.

cwelcc_fee_cap_daily.unit: max base fee per child per day, under 6, CWELCC-enrolled licensed care
cwelcc_fee_cap_daily.note: Provincial average reported $19/day. The $10/day average target for March 2026 was NOT met (CCPA Aug 2026, read from page). Search summary: agreement extended to 2031 with fees held at current rates until at least 30 June 2027 (unverified).

ten_a_day_childcarebc_daily.unit: per child per day at a $10 a Day ChildCareBC centre, full-time

ccfri_reduction_under36mo_group_monthly.unit: max fee reduction per child, full-time group care under 36 months
ccfri_reduction_under36mo_group_monthly.note: Family care under 36 mo: $600. 3y-kindergarten: $545 group / $500 family. Kindergarten $320. Grade 1-12: $115 group / $145 family. Preschool $95. Not income-tested. Parent fee floor $200/month full-time.

accb_max_monthly.unit: max Affordable Child Care Benefit per child
accb_max_monthly.note: Income-tested; maximum generally at family income under ~$45,000; eligibility up to $111,000 (income limit read on the CCFRI families page).

imss_guarderias.note: Free for IMSS-insured working parents; ages 43 days-4 years. ISSSTE runs equivalent EBDIs for public employees (not verified here).

bienestar_madres_trabajadoras_bimonthly.unit: per child under 4 (under 6 if disabled), max 3 per household
bienestar_madres_trabajadoras_bimonthly.note: Programa de Apoyo para el Bienestar de las Niñas y Niños, Hijos de Madres Trabajadoras. For working/studying/job-seeking mothers, lone fathers or guardians WITHOUT IMSS/ISSSTE childcare (non-affiliation certificates required). Search summary: disabled child 3,720 MXN bimonthly; 2026 rules published DOF 13 Feb 2026.

cdmx_cacdi.note: DIF CDMX CACDI: 45 days-5y11m, for parents without social-security childcare; cost not verified (official site unreachable).

united_states._note: USDA 'Expenditures on Children by Families, 2015' (Lino et al., Jan 2017) is the last edition. Table 1, overall US, married couple, younger child of two, 2015 dollars. Read from PDF. Only child: multiply by 1.27; 3+ children: x0.76.

brookings_inflated_total.unit: total birth to 17, middle-income married couple, child born 2015
brookings_inflated_total.note: Brookings (Aug 2022) re-projection of USDA 2015 at higher inflation; a nominal sum across future years, NOT today's annual cost.

cpag_2025_couple_to_18_full.unit: total cost to age 18, couple, incl. rent and childcare (rounded)
cpag_2025_couple_to_18_full.note: CPAG Cost of a Child 2025 (23 Oct 2025), based on JRF Minimum Income Standard. PDF and page blocked (403). No age-band breakdown obtained.

cpag_2025_lone_parent_to_18_full.unit: total cost to age 18, lone parent, incl. rent and childcare (rounded)

cpag_2025_couple_basic_to_18.unit: basic cost excluding rent and childcare
cpag_2025_couple_basic_to_18.note: Search summary gave £167,679 but attributed it to the Scotland 2025 report; not confirmed for UK, so left null.

ireland._note: Vincentian MESL 2025 (budgeting.ie), urban, excluding childcare, adjusted for full Medical Card. PDF fetched but the weekly child figures sit in a graph that did not extract; values from search summary.

mesl_2025_weekly_by_age.unit: per child per week, minimum essential standard of living, excl. childcare
mesl_2025_weekly_by_age.note: PDF text confirms: infant basket fell €13.53/wk on review, pre-school rose €16.95/wk (30.7%); core welfare supports meet 113% (infant), ~115% (pre-school), 88% (primary), 64% (second level) of MESL need.

canada._note: Statistics Canada 'Estimating Expenditures on Children by Families in Canada, 2014 to 2017' (2023). Two-parent, two-child families, 2017 constant dollars. Read from page.

medium_income_by_age.unit: per child per year; household income $83,013-$135,790

higher_income_by_age.note: One-parent families: lower income total $231,260; medium-high $372,110.

official_estimate.note: No INEGI or government cost-of-a-child estimate found. Media cite 1.3-2.5 million MXN to age 18 attributed to Profeco/IMCO, and 7-9 million MXN in other outlets; both unverified and inconsistent, so not used.

ctc_max_per_child_2026.note: IRS page: up to $2,200. OBBBA made it permanent and indexed; search summary says Rev. Proc. 2025-32 keeps it at $2,200 for 2026.

actc_refundable_max_2026.note: Requires earned income of at least $2,500; refund = 15% of earnings over $2,500 up to the cap (15% rate not re-read here).

phaseout_start_single.note: Reduction of $50 per $1,000 over (statutory; not re-read on page).

ssn_requirement.value: Taxpayer (and spouse if MFJ) and each child must have an SSN valid for employment, issued before the return due date

hicbc_threshold.unit: adjusted net income of higher earner
hicbc_threshold.note: Charge = 1% of Child Benefit per £200 over £60,000; full benefit repaid at £80,000. Search summary confirms unchanged for 2026/27.

child_benefit_monthly_2026.note: No change in Budget 2026. Twins 1.5x (€210/child), triplets+ 2x (€280/child). Paid to age 16, or 18 in full-time education/disability. New Baby Grant €280 extra with first payment (children born from 1 Dec 2024). gov.ie and citizensinformation.ie blocked fetch (403).

ccb_max_under6_2026_27.note: Tax-free. Child Disability Benefit up to $3,480/yr extra.

ccb_phaseout.unit: adjusted family net income thresholds and reduction rates
ccb_phaseout.note: Above $82,847: reduction = fixed amount + second rate x (AFNI - 82,847).

universal_child_benefit.note: Mexico has no universal child benefit. Targeted programmes: Madres Trabajadoras (1,650 MXN bimonthly per child under 4, see childcare_subsidies) and Beca Rita Cetina (below).

beca_rita_cetina_secundaria_bimonthly.unit: per family with one public-secondary student; +700 per additional student
beca_rita_cetina_secundaria_bimonthly.note: Universal for public secundaria students. Unofficial source; official gob.mx page returned 404.

beca_rita_cetina_primaria.note: Reported as an annual payment for supplies/uniforms from 2026; unverified against official rules.

school_costs._note: Public schooling is tuition-free in all six places (US public K-12, UK state schools, Irish free-scheme schools, Ontario/BC public, Mexican public SEP schools; Irish and Mexican public schools may ask 'voluntary contributions'/cuotas).

elite_independent_day_tuition_range.unit: per pupil, top Manhattan/Bronx independent day schools
elite_independent_day_tuition_range.note: Examples: Brearley $69,600, Chapin $68,250, Horace Mann $68,700, Spence $68,480, Dalton $70,800, Trinity $69,000, Collegiate $68,900, Fieldston $68,162. Not school-verified.

nysais_average_tuition.unit: per pupil, NYSAIS member schools statewide average
nysais_average_tuition.note: Third-party aggregator, statewide; no NAIS/NYSAIS official median found.

harvard_westlake_tuition.note: Official page blocked (403). Other sources show $54,900 (likely 2026-27).

isc_london_average_day_fee_per_term_ex_v.unit: per pupil per term, average London day school, excluding VAT
isc_london_average_day_fee_per_term_ex_v.note: Derived: £22,308/yr ex VAT; £26,770/yr with 20% VAT (VAT on fees since 1 Jan 2025). UK average day fee £5,985/term (£17,955/yr) ex VAT excl. SEND schools; on average schools passed on 14.0% of the 20% VAT.

fee_paying_secondary_examples.note: Irish Times July 2025. Alexandra College fee page links its 2026/27 schedule but shows no figure. Supports a typical range of roughly €7,000-€9,000; the €10,000 upper hint was not confirmed.

upper_canada_college_day_tuition.note: Plus $10,000 initial registration fee. Official UCC page blocked (403). No CAIS official average exists; Toronto established day schools roughly high $30,000s to ~$49,500 (2026-27, search summary).

st_georges_day_tuition_range.note: Official page 404; Our Kids blocked. BC independent schools get partial provincial funding, so many non-elite schools are far cheaper (not quantified).

private_primary_monthly_range_cdmx.unit: per pupil, colegiatura (monthly tuition), private primaria in CDMX
private_primary_monthly_range_cdmx.note: Media estimate; budget schools in CDMX start ~1,500-2,500 MXN/month. Usually 10 monthly payments plus inscripción; extras add 30-50%. Profeco's last CDMX comparative survey (749 schools) was 2019 (read from gob.mx page) and its tables were not extracted.
